title: Nourishing Basque Poppy Seeds Stew
description: A garlicky, flaky stew packed with ground poppy seeds and colorful veggies for a kid-friendly Basque twist.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onions and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced bell peppers and zucchini, and cook, stirring, for 7 minutes until vegetables soften.
Sprinkle ground poppy seeds, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to coat the vegetables.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and let cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for another 10 minutes until flavors meld and the stew thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then remove from heat.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
Serve hot with crusty bread or a side of rice.
